FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION — relayed verbatim by Fable exactly as Samuel supplied it. This is Samuel's text, not mine; I am not the executor and I have taken no database action. It names A as the executor. The full text follows between the markers, unaltered.

----- BEGIN FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION -----
APPROVED: BOUNDED CHECKOUT-EXECUTIONS STAGING REHEARSAL

I, Samuel Boadu, authorize Codex A to install and qualify this exact existing migration candidate on the existing nonproduction project tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro, after source review and fresh prechecks pass:

Repository: teamxenios/xenios-website
Source: 41a9c623f045f83b3427207b772fe26bfb417026
Path: supabase/candidates/20260909150000_research_checkout_executions.sql
Git blob: dbbaa4f772b62d7d85159b52065f5ad507ae0831

Verify and record the exact content SHA-256 before applying. The observed candidate is the same Git blob as at c70b77e1568d77465aeb23aad662ff7aa28916f8. Do not substitute changed SQL under this approval.

Permitted effects: this candidate's two new tables, transition functions, trigger/index/grant configuration, the corresponding managed migration-history registration, postchecks, and the documented synthetic rehearsal and managed-adapter test writes within this staging project. Review and scope every fixture and any existing triggers before execution; use only synthetic data and approved test-only provider integration. Capture the rehearsal's rollback result, and remove or retain test fixtures only as documented in the reviewed plan.

Do not reset shared staging, replay an existing migration, alter production, use real customer data, send customer communications, charge or refund real money, ship anything, or create paid resources. This statement does not approve additional migrations, including any recovery/outbox follow-on. Present any necessary changed SQL/effects as one precise amendment.

This closes the identified staging-permission question only. It does not declare tests passed, provide missing Stripe credentials or authorize a production release. Continue other already-authorized local integration and test work in parallel.
----- END FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION -----

FABLE NOTES, clearly separate from the authorization above:
1. It authorizes ONE apply of ONE named blob (dbbaa4f772b62d7d85159b52065f5ad507ae0831 at source 41a9c623f045f83b3427207b772fe26bfb417026, path supabase/candidates/20260909150000_research_checkout_executions.sql) to tetynodzrtmdbuzgboro, after your own source review and fresh prechecks. Verify the content SHA-256 yourself before applying; do not take my word that the blob matches c70b77e.
2. It explicitly does NOT approve a second migration, so the recovery/outbox follow-on work needs its own separate candidate and its own approval. Present any needed change as one precise amendment rather than editing the approved candidate.
3. Rerun-behaviour and true two-session concurrency belong in the isolated rehearsal setup described in the runbook, not a second apply to shared staging.
4. It is not permission for production, real money, customer messages, shipments or paid resources, and it does not supply Stripe credentials.
5. Independent review of source content before applying is on you: I authored this SQL, so my reading of it is not the review.
